decision.summary: Urgent no-heating job raised to emergency because tenant is vulnerable and it is cold. HeatRight assignment failed once then verified on retry; HeatRight no-showed, so Swift was assigned for the same afternoon, tenant and landlord told, and P1 escalated.

answers.question: What happened when you assigned the contractor and how did you verify it?
answers.answer: First attempt to assign HeatRight returned HTTP 500 and the ledger showed NOT APPLIED (A1 attempt 1). I retried once; it verified by read-back at stage visit (A1 attempt 2). I only told the tenant after that.

answers.question: What do you tell the tenant at each point?
answers.answer: After verified booking: HeatRight visit 11 Oct 8am-12pm, gas number, hear from us after the visit (MSG-101). After the no-show: apology, explanation, Swift booked 3-7pm same day, gas number, update this evening if unresolved (MSG-102; API reported timeout but read-back showed it sent).

answers.question: After the no-show, what do you do?
answers.answer: Recorded missed_appointment, assigned Swift (the other approved contractor) same day under the landlord's emergency approval, emailed the landlord, escalated P1, and set a follow-up FUP-104.

actions_claimed.description: Emailed tenant apology and new slot (read-back confirmed despite timeout error)

assumptions: The no-show day's events are treated as occurring after the first booking; Swift window 15:00-19:00 chosen as same-day target.
